fields.subject: Measles case in Marston County: clinician actions
fields.summary: One confirmed measles case has been identified in a county resident. The person was in a clinic waiting room, a school and a flight while infectious. Clinicians should consider measles in patients with fever and rash.
fields.caseDefinition: Confirmed: acute febrile rash with laboratory confirmation. Probable: meets the clinical description with an epidemiologic link to a confirmed case.
recommendations: Mask and isolate patients with suspected measles immediately, in an airborne infection isolation room if available.
Obtain a nasopharyngeal or throat swab for PCR and a serum sample through the public health laboratory.
Check the vaccination status of exposed patients and staff.
Report suspected cases by phone the same day. Do not wait for laboratory results.
fields.reporting: Call the Communicable Disease Program at (555) 014-2290 (24 hours).
fields.distribution: Hospitals, urgent care centers, pediatric and family practices, school nurses
